hooks.name: skill-radar-session-start
hooks.description: Generate and persist a session id for trace correlation; observability-only, never blocks

hooks.name: skill-radar-log-invocation
hooks.description: Append a JSONL trace for this tool invocation; exits 0 on any error

hooks.name: skill-radar-log-failure
hooks.description: Append a JSONL trace for this failed tool invocation; exits 0 on any error

hooks.name: skill-radar-prompt-submit
hooks.description: Append a JSONL trace for user prompt submission (prompt size + redacted excerpt); never stores full prompt

hooks.name: skill-radar-stop-signal
hooks.description: Detect negative signal in the last assistant message and append to signals log; never blocks
